-- REVIEW-ONLY B05 V010 candidate. NOT frozen, NOT in a Flyway location, NEVER applied.

-- Derived only from adopted B00-1.2, frozen V005, and root empty-legacy maintenance ruling.

-- Prerequisite: stop ALL writers/workers, approved ordered 001/002/005/006/007/008/009, verified empty legacy work.

-- Root independent lower-migration reviews + final SHA freeze acknowledgment are STILL REQUIRED.

-- Nonempty/unknown history fails before permanent DDL. Never repair, reset sequence, infer inputs or delete source rows.

SET NAMES utf8mb4;

SET time_zone = '+00:00';

CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE b05_v010_preflight (compatible TINYINT NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT ck_b05_v010_compatible CHECK(compatible=1));

INSERT INTO b05_v010_preflight SELECT (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(version ORDER BY installed_rank SEPARATOR ',') FROM flyway_schema_history WHERE version IS NOT NULL) = '001,002,005,006,007,008,009' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM flyway_schema_history WHERE success<>1);

INSERT INTO b05_v010_preflight SELECT NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM durable_task);

INSERT INTO b05_v010_preflight SELECT NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM task_outbox);

INSERT INTO b05_v010_preflight SELECT NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM model_reservation);

INSERT INTO b05_v010_preflight SELECT NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM model_capacity);

INSERT INTO b05_v010_preflight SELECT COUNT(*)=1 AND MIN(id)=1 AND MIN(next_id)=1 FROM task_outbox_sequence;

INSERT INTO b05_v010_preflight SELECT NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM task_subject s WHERE CAST(s.subject_kind AS BINARY)<>_binary'MEETING' OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM meeting m WHERE CAST(m.id AS BINARY)=CAST(s.subject_id AS BINARY) AND m.revision=s.business_version AND m.cancel_epoch=s.cancel_epoch AND m.lifecycle='ACTIVE'));

-- Exact frozen lower tables; reject drift before any permanent DDL.
INSERT INTO b05_v010_preflight SELECT COUNT(*)=6 AND COALESCE(SUM(JSON_CONTAINS(CONVERT( USING utf8mb4), row_json)),0)=6 FROM (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('table',TABLE_NAME,'engine',ENGINE,'collation',TABLE_COLLATION) AS row_json FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE()) AS actual WHERE JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(row_json,'$.table')) IN ('durable_task','external_execution','external_operation','model_capacity','model_reservation','outbox_consumer','task_attempt','task_outbox','task_outbox_sequence','task_subject');

-- Exact frozen lower columns; reject drift before any permanent DDL.
INSERT INTO b05_v010_preflight SELECT COUNT(*)=33 AND COALESCE(SUM(JSON_CONTAINS(CONVERT( USING utf8mb4), row_json)),0)=33 FROM (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('table',TABLE_NAME,'column',COLUMN_NAME,'ordinal',ORDINAL_POSITION,'type',COLUMN_TYPE,'nullable',IS_NULLABLE,'default',COLUMN_DEFAULT,'collation',COLLATION_NAME,'extra',EXTRA) AS row_json FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE()) AS actual WHERE JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(row_json,'$.table')) IN ('durable_task','external_execution','external_operation','model_capacity','model_reservation','outbox_consumer','task_attempt','task_outbox','task_outbox_sequence','task_subject');

-- Exact frozen lower indexes; reject drift before any permanent DDL.
INSERT INTO b05_v010_preflight SELECT COUNT(*)=16 AND COALESCE(SUM(JSON_CONTAINS(CONVERT( USING utf8mb4), row_json)),0)=16 FROM (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('table',TABLE_NAME,'name',INDEX_NAME,'unique',1-NON_UNIQUE,'seq',SEQ_IN_INDEX,'column',COLUMN_NAME,'direction',COLLATION,'prefix',SUB_PART,'type',INDEX_TYPE) AS row_json FROM information_schema.STATISTICS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE()) AS actual WHERE JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(row_json,'$.table')) IN ('durable_task','external_execution','external_operation','model_capacity','model_reservation','outbox_consumer','task_attempt','task_outbox','task_outbox_sequence','task_subject');

-- Exact frozen lower checks; reject drift before any permanent DDL.
INSERT INTO b05_v010_preflight SELECT COUNT(*)=4 AND COALESCE(SUM(JSON_CONTAINS(CONVERT( USING utf8mb4), row_json)),0)=4 FROM (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('table',t.TABLE_NAME,'name',t.CONSTRAINT_NAME,'clause',c.CHECK_CLAUSE,'enforced',t.ENFORCED) AS row_json FROM information_schema.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS t JOIN information_schema.CHECK_CONSTRAINTS c ON c.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA=t.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA AND c.CONSTRAINT_NAME=t.CONSTRAINT_NAME WHERE t.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND t.CONSTRAINT_TYPE='CHECK') AS actual WHERE JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(row_json,'$.table')) IN ('durable_task','external_execution','external_operation','model_capacity','model_reservation','outbox_consumer','task_attempt','task_outbox','task_outbox_sequence','task_subject');

-- Exact frozen lower foreign_keys; reject drift before any permanent DDL.
INSERT INTO b05_v010_preflight SELECT COUNT(*)=4 AND COALESCE(SUM(JSON_CONTAINS(CONVERT( USING utf8mb4), row_json)),0)=4 FROM (SELECT JSON_OBJECT('table',k.TABLE_NAME,'name',k.CONSTRAINT_NAME,'column',k.COLUMN_NAME,'ordinal',k.ORDINAL_POSITION,'target',k.REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME,'remote',k.REFERENCED_COLUMN_NAME,'delete',r.DELETE_RULE,'update',r.UPDATE_RULE) AS row_json FROM information_schema.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE k JOIN information_schema.REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS r ON r.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA=k.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA AND r.CONSTRAINT_NAME=k.CONSTRAINT_NAME WHERE k.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND k.REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME IS NOT NULL) AS actual WHERE JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(row_json,'$.table')) IN ('durable_task','external_execution','external_operation','model_capacity','model_reservation','outbox_consumer','task_attempt','task_outbox','task_outbox_sequence','task_subject');

DROP TEMPORARY TABLE b05_v010_preflight;
